## Changes: * #4809: Update github copilot npm package * #4844: Add workspace metadata (git branch, commit, remote, file path) to OTel events and GH telemetry * #4839: Fix whitespace-only text block from orphaned CacheBreakpoint * #4835: Agent Debug: max session logs to retain * #4827: Use one WebSocket per conversation * #4788: Disable Claude co-attribution in commits/PRs * #4831: Clear workspace changes before retrieving modified files in FolderRepositoryManager * #4832: add prompting for HiddenFamilyH * #4828: Copilot CLI Controller API * #4833: Sessions - adopt new context key
See More * #4830: Fix skill directory access * #4806: Clean up conversation store entries when chat sessions are disposed * #4829: Background - include repositoryPath for folder sessions * #2660: Bump the all group across 1 directory with 4 updates * #4820: Use selected model when starting Copilot coding agent task * #4810: Add new CAPI standard header for assignment context * #4825: Sessions - limit when we show the discard changes action * #4304: Allow invoking simulationMain with alternative action input * #4786: Bump brace-expansion from 1.1.12 to 1.1.13 * #4822: chore: skip nuget MCP tests until less flaky * #4821: Sessions - prefer upstream for the base branch when present * #4817: Background - clean-up log statements * #4816: Background - do not stage changes for folder sessions * #4815: Bump version * #4785: Attach response output message IDs only to phased assistant messages * #4814: Fix background compaction not applied between tool calls This list of changes was [auto generated](https://dev.azure.com/monacotools/Monaco/_build/results?buildId=425896&view=logs).
